parsed.claim: There is a concrete edge labeling of the complete graph on Fin 2 with 1 colour that satisfies the TriangleFree definition, so the definition is satisfiable. The proof uses the fact that a graph on 2 vertices has no 3-clique.
parsed.lean:
theorem probe_nv : ∃ C : SimpleGraph.TopEdgeLabeling (Fin 2) (Fin 1), ErdosProblems.MulticolourTriangleRamsey.TriangleFree C := by
  refine ⟨fun _ => 0, fun c => ?_⟩
  exact SimpleGraph.cliqueFree_of_card_lt (by simp)
